# This is a reusable workflow

# This workflow builds the test image for testing purposes

name: Build Test Image

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      gateway-image:
        description: Name of the Gateway image (base) to use
        type: string
    outputs:
      image:
        description: Name of the Gateway test image being built
        value: ${{ jobs.build-test-image.outputs.image }}

jobs:
  build-test-image:
    name: Build test image
    runs-on: ${{ vars.RUNS_ON }}
    outputs:
      image: ${{ steps.build-and-save.outputs.image }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout source code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Download release
        timeout-minutes: 5
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4.1.3
        with:
          name: release

      - name: Unpack release
        run: tar xzvf ./release.tar.gz

      - name: Select Gateway image
        id: select-gateway-image
        uses: ./.github/actions/select-gateway-image
        with:
          current-image: ${{ inputs.gateway-image }}

      - name: Pull and inspect base image
        timeout-minutes: 5
        run: |
          docker pull ${{ steps.select-gateway-image.outputs.image }}
          docker inspect ${{ steps.select-gateway-image.outputs.image }}

      - name: Build and save image
        id: build-and-save
        env:
          GATEWAY_IMAGE: ${{ steps.select-gateway-image.outputs.image }}
          GATEWAY_TEST_IMAGE: kong/internal-testing-kong-manager:${{ github.sha }} # Image name here is only used for internal testing
        run: |
          export KONG_MANAGER_BUILD_SHA1=$(cat dist/build.sha1)
          docker compose -f .ci/docker-compose.yml build kong-test-image
          docker save $GATEWAY_TEST_IMAGE | gzip > docker-test-image.tar.gz
          echo "image=$GATEWAY_TEST_IMAGE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Upload test image
        timeout-minutes: 5
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: docker-test-image
          path: ./docker-test-image.tar.gz
          if-no-files-found: error # It's meaningless to continue if the image is missing

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
